notes.title: Workshop content usage hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that prevented playing some newer challenge levels and using ship blueprints downloaded from the workshop.
These would show up in the game, but e.g. trying to add such ships to a level would just fail without any error message. The root cause was that the Steam workshop item IDs for new items are now larger numbers than what a 32-bit Integer can hold, which hasn't been an issue before.

New feature updates will come eventually when those are ready. The "development" beta branch will get these first if you don't mind having some bugs.

notes.title: 0.2.1906.10 First version of campaign prototype
notes.notes:
The default branch now includes a very early version of a "survival sandbox" overworld where you have a persistent fleet in a small universe of warring factions.

It only has minimal graphics and UI, but many of the intended core mechanics are there such as Newtonian fleet movement, persistent fleet damage, resource scavenging from battle debris, power struggle between AI factions, and a simple resource economy to generate fleets for you to raid.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30166125/55fcfe6a4b2287a8a92a6c08f9c9a4e84a32f566.png[/img]

Please let me know what you think. It has been quite a while since last update, so I thought releasing this in the current state is better than just continuing the radio silence while making slow progress.

notes.title: Version 0.2! New damage model and game balance. Updated ship library and battle challenges.
notes.notes:
The major damage model and game balance changes have been in the beta branch for a while. This update makes them official and contains updated battle challenges, bug fixes. See previous announcements for details about the changes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30166125/e37c428c8fc9812001ec365c4245dc220dcdb440.png[/img]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
	[*]Armor plate simulation with per-segment damage independent from module damage
	[*]Explosion simulation
	[*]Armor piercing explosive projectiles that explode after penetrating
	[*]Projectile passthrough, ship internal ricochets
	[*]Projectile penetration, armor plate and module damage visualization
	[*]Beam (weapon) penetration and passthrough, distance-based shield interaction
[/list]

[b]Content changes[/b]
[list]
	[*]All stock ship designs either improved or replaced with new ones
	[*]Existing challenge levels updated and tweaked to take the new game balance into account
	[*]3 new challenge levels: "Canyon battle", "Obstacle race 2", "Obstacle race 3"
[/list]

[b]Imrovements and fixes since the previous beta version[/b]
[list]
	[*]Implemented new collision avoidance check that calculates where the ship would stop if it "hit the brakes" and tries to stop the ship if that point is inside an obstacle or outside level bounds.
	[*]Improved ship movement along (around) asteroids by fixing some issues and adding some new flight control logic for that
	[*]Improved "movement disabled" check that is a condition in enemy ship surrendering logic
	[*]Fixed fleet creation challenges sometimes getting the enemy ships moved and asteroids added to them
	[*]Fixed some rare exceptions / crash related to ships getting disabled
	[*]Fixed projectiles that exit ship to a void left by a single module within the ship not colliding again with the ship properly, causing them to pass through some modules
	[*]Fixed player fleet ship listing not showing at all in battle setup screen if the fleet contains ships that are not in the blueprint library
[/list]

Full version number: 0.2.1802.10

notes.title: Version 0.1.1710.09 - Bug fixes and some usability improvements.
notes.notes:
This is a maintenance update without significant new features, but some of the fixes do affect gameplay.

[h1]Usability changes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fleet editor now opens with a core only ship already in it. Note that you can always easily restore your previous fleet setup by loading the "autosave" fleet.
	[*]Free skirmish battle setup screen now automatically remembers last used settings within session.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed missiles being pointlessly transferred between launchers. Missiles now get launched faster overall, in salvos of equal size.
	[*]Fixed point defence not working when the ship didn't have a primary target.
	[*]Tweaked fighting to escaping battle AI trigger logic so that missile heavy ship designs will stick around to use their other weapons as well.
	[*]Fixed display of fleet, level, and battle file modification date when using a different locale.
	[*]No longer possible to enter direct ship control mode in deployment phase by using its shortcut key.
	[*]Fixed redoing in ship editor causing reference to the ship's original blueprint getting lost.
	[*]Fixed rebuild action in ship editor creating an incorrect undo state containing only the ship's core.
	[*]Fixed an oversight that allowed non-core module to be set as origin in ship editor, causing the ship to become permanently disabled.
	[*]Fixed surrendered ships potentially getting re-activated when split by enemy fire.
	[*]Fixed scrolling in menus affecting initial camera zoom when entering battle, battle editor, or fleet editor screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.1709.27 - Ship editor mirror tool
notes.notes:
This patch adds a very handy mirroring tool to ship editor, improves ship movement and fixed weapon firing accuracy.
[list]
    [*]Added a tool that can mirror your ship design by any horizontal or vertical axis, replacing the other side. This can effectively reduce your module placement effort by half! Works with undo as well.
    [*]Reimplemented some core motion control math to take moving target frame's own movement during planned motion into account. Generally ships should now reach and keep their desired engagement distance better.
    [*]Improved fixed weapon accuracy by refining their firing timing algorithm. The logic now extrapolates motion of the weapon and target to expected next frame's time and doesn't fire if the next frame's firing solution seems to yield a hit closer to the target's center.
    [*]Some small / rare bugs fixed.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30166125/134a9e3df7f984f30973dff30a805437a0277b87.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.1.1709.13 - Steam Workshop integration for ship designs
notes.notes:
This update brings easy sharing of ship designs through the Steam Workshop and some related smaller changes. The workshop integration took significant amount of work, but it should now work pretty well.

[list]
    [*]Ship blueprints can now be downloaded from Steam Workshop using the common item subscription system. Game restart is not needed to add subscriptions.
    [*]Player-made ship blueprints can now be published to Steam Workshop from the ship blueprint browser in Fleet & Ship Editor screen.
    [*]Added function to delete blueprints from the the ship blueprint browser in Fleet & Ship Editor screen.
    [*]Added option to exclude a blueprint from auto-generated fleets. It is accessible in the "save as" dialog for blueprints. [b]You need to resave your existing ship designs to include them in generated fleets.[/b]
    [*]Ship blueprint browser in Fleet & Ship Editor screen now automatically refreshes when a blueprint is saved.
    [*]Added icons to ship blueprint browser that indicate if the blueprint is player-made or downloaded from Steam Workshop.
    [*]Some other small fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.1708.26 - Quality of life improvements
notes.notes:
This patch brings few smaller features and improvements based on player feedback.
[list]
    [*]Implemented selection groups feature for battles. Select units and press ctrl + number key 1-0 to set group. Then press the number key to select ships in that group.
    [*]Changed camera panning keys to be WASD by default. The new default is not applied automatically. You need to rebind or delete bindings from you settings file.
    [*]Expanded support for the rebindable camera panning keys to editors and when following a ship in battle.
    [*]Added a camera panning speed setting to settings screen.
    [*]Replaced "Version" column in ship blueprint browser wtih "Author" column to make finding your own designs easier.
    [*]Added game version display to main menu.
    [*]Fixed disabled thrusters causing incorrect movement group effect calculation.
    [*]Unified .NET Framework target to version 4.5.2 and x86 on all assemblies.
[/list]

Selection groups UI:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30166125/88559e8b746321bff130175fcc1e8c506ad8ca24.png[/img]
